description: Stark black-and-gray minimalist presentation template in a Swiss/brutalist voice: pure black canvas, warm gray and off-white type, giant neutral-grotesque headlines at extreme scale, rigid grid, hairline rules, numbered sections 01–10, and vast negative space — the typography is the design. One inverted light slide for rhythm. Cover, agenda, big statement, text with bullets, two columns, stat band, quote, SVG visual interlude, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
name: Monument
